content: libgit2: no exceptions; functions return int (0=GIT_OK, negative=error code from small enum GIT_ENOTFOUND/GIT_EEXISTS/GIT_EAMBIGUOUS/GIT_EBUFS etc.); extended error detail (message, class) lives in thread-local storage retrieved via git_error_last(). Guidance: keep each function's error surface to 2-3 expected error variants max. This validates mediadiff's expected<T,Error> approach but flags a gap: libgit2's thread-local-last-error pattern is exactly what NOT to copy in a library meant to be called from a bounded worker pool (dir mode) -- thread-local state doesn't compose with per-file worker threads unless carefully scoped; mediadiff's Error must be carried in the return value (as designed) not in a side channel.
